title: Move Point
statement: Implement `solve(x, y, dx, dy)`. A point is an immutable pair. Return `[x+dx, y+dy]`, a new point. The inputs are the old coordinates. There is nothing to mutate.
starter_code:
def solve(x, y, dx, dy):
    pass
hints: Add the deltas to the coordinates.
Return a new list. Do not try to update a tuple in place.
Zero deltas return the same numbers.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Tuples do not support item assignment.

editorial: Tuples do not support item assignment. A moved point is a new pair. That is the whole model: coordinates in, new coordinates out, no hidden object to update.
reference_solution:
def solve(x, y, dx, dy):
    return [x + dx, y + dy]
